handoffs.restriction: Publication must reread current product/variant/media lifecycle and permission; media review is not product publication, and a shared confirmation is not an extra endpoint.
handoffs.recovery: Return to originating entity and focus the triggering control; retain safe unsaved fields only.

handoffs.restriction: Apply only the exact supported preview/hash/version protocol; raw workbook payload must never appear in logs, URL or audit UI. Informational previews do not become apply tokens.
handoffs.recovery: On stale hash/version reread and explicitly preview again; never automatically retry an apply.

handoffs.restriction: Receipts, stock layers and financial cost records retain owner lineage and integer Toman. Link to separately authorized reads; do not create a second stock or cost mutation from navigation.
handoffs.recovery: Unknown receipt/reversal result requires authorized status review; keep original and compensating references distinct.

handoffs.restriction: Admin order surface remains NO_ACTION. Payment/refund may be entered independently only with valid identifiers and its own permission; guest tokens/customer routes cannot bridge the blocked source.
handoffs.recovery: Unknown provider outcome requires explicit supported reconciliation; no fake success or automatic charge/refund retry.

handoffs.restriction: Blocked order reads do not unlock allocation or shipment actions. Each destination needs its own authority and lifecycle; allocation/consumption and dispatch remain separate owner effects.
handoffs.recovery: Preserve entity context without guessing identifiers; resolve current owner status before a repeated command.

handoffs.restriction: Resolution uses owner-supported outcomes and immutable inspection evidence; a return or warranty decision does not imply successful stock receipt or refund. No extra settlement or retry endpoint.
handoffs.recovery: Return to the case with server outcome and separate inventory/refund status; unknown side effects require manual review.

handoffs.restriction: Customer admin reads remain blocked; wholesale review uses its independently permitted application evidence. Approval is under_review only and source-owned promotion, never UI self-promotion or invented discounts.
handoffs.recovery: Keep application id and terminal response; reread supported application view before moving to separately authorized pricing.

context: offline command id and sale snapshot
handoffs.restriction: POS uses owner stock/pricing and immutable sale snapshots; offline enqueue is not accepted sale. No parallel stock ledger, rewritten terminal receipt or blind command replay.
handoffs.recovery: Reconcile each supported offline command by its original identity; separate rejected/unknown/accepted outcomes.

handoffs.restriction: AI surfaces remain NO_ACTION, so no generated draft or automatic article handoff can be executed. Article editing uses its own authorized input, and edit/restore never silently replaces published truth.
handoffs.recovery: Keep conceptual source review separate from executable article commands; return safely with no fabricated AI result.

handoffs.restriction: Final profit/distribution is not payout. Finance JSON-envelope export does not inherit analytics owner binding, private headers or CSV formula safety; download permission and Step-Up are independently enforced.
handoffs.recovery: Unknown export result needs status review; never automatically open, send or substitute another user’s analytic export.

context: staff id distinct from account id
handoffs.restriction: RBAC writes stay NO_ACTION; staff role/scope replacement uses exact If-Match/Step-Up and revokes sessions. Empty scope is global for that type; IAM account lock does not inherit last-superadmin staff protections.
handoffs.recovery: Restore safe focus after confirmation cancellation; after session revocation use supported sign-in and reread permissions, never persist enrollment secrets.

handoffs.restriction: Provider switching remains NO_ACTION. Configuration preview is advisory, approve is not apply, rollback is first-two key history across scopes. Notification retry is eligible sms/email requeue, not delivered success.
handoffs.recovery: Reread each independently authorized owner; no cascade retry, promised scheduled worker or persisted feature-preview targets.

handoffs.restriction: These operations surfaces remain NO_ACTION including reads; no retry/restore/repair success or cross-domain execution is enabled by completing H. Release requires canonical source and permission reconciliation.
handoffs.recovery: Unavailable explanation and safe exit only; do not route through internal, customer or direct database workarounds.
